Bug_Title: RV: Random value from 0 to 1 is coerced to the integer 0 (RV_01_TO_INT)
Bug_Details:
A random value from 0 to 1 is being coerced to the integer value 0. You probably
want to multiply the random value by something else before coercing it to an integer, or use the Random.nextInt(n) method.
 Random.nextInt(n)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by casting the result of random.nextDouble(), which returns a double value between 0.0 (inclusive) and 1.0 (exclusive), directly to an integer. This coercion always results in 0 because the decimal part is discarded.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the RandomValueBug class. The method returns 0 due to the bug, and the test expects a result of 1, causing the test to fail.
